description: Documentation du Service de la navigation fluviale is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Service de la navigation fluviale. Information brochures. Coverage: Service de la navigation fluviale. The portal shows the English title as "Documentation of the River Navigation Service" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Service de la navigation fluviale. Its keywords include voie-deau, transports-voie-deau, cadre-reglementaire, leaflet, voie-navigable, mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is notspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
